mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases without triggering inflation concerns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate hiring slowdowns depress earnings expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as economic growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days during industrial contraction regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales growth consistently boosts corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as consumer spending strengthens.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 3.0% signals monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as policy restrictiveness intensifies.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and industrial production declines signal dual economic stress, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as growth fears intensify.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price inflation triggers central bank hawkishness that reduces equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days during high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
